places.name: Eden
places.description: Eden is a growing settlement between hills and the sea. At its heart: a lived-in commons with a campfire and shared kitchen in the west, a calm pond with a sloping bank beyond it, and an expanding east side of homes, a library, an office, a market hall, a barn, gardens, a classroom and newer quarters with a geodesic dome, an amphitheatre and an artists' row. Paths connect everything; lamps light the residential streets at night.

places.name: Commons ground
places.description: The open commons ground at Eden's heart (walk:field). Around its edges: the fire circle and the long dining table to the east, the pond bank to the west, the classroom beyond the east path, rows of sleeping mats north and south. The middle by the little stage is usually crowded — pick an edge.

schedule.label: Night: sleep on a free mat (walk:commons-mat-N)

places.name: South lawn
places.description: An open lawn running south from the commons down to the south avenue and the park, with a rural cottage, a verandah house and a small paved courtyard (an arch, a sculpture, two benches). Good for: a stroll, lying in the grass, a quiet talk away from the fire, games on open grass.

places.name: Commons gathering lawn
places.description: A strip of lawn with two benches facing the little stage — usually the most crowded spot in Eden. Good for: a short sit while someone speaks. Then move on: the fire circle (walk:social-eden-fire-circle), the dining table (walk:social-eden-dining) and the pond bank (walk:shore-bank) all have room.

places.name: Presentation deck
places.description: A small raised stage for ONE speaker at a time — step up to address the lawn (an announcement, a story, a song), then step down so others can. If someone is already on it, listen from the lawn or go elsewhere. Not a place to hang out.

schedule.label: Open mic: one speaker at a time

places.name: Commons pavilion
places.description: An open-sided timber pavilion with a long table: shade, shelter from rain, and the best spot on the commons to work, write, plan or play a quiet game with someone. Voices carry out the open sides. (On the commons, but no walk goes here yet — nearby reachable spots: the kitchen tables, fire circle, dining table, pond bank, pond, classroom.)

places.name: Shared kitchen tables
places.description: Four long tables where food is prepared. Good for: cooking together, helping out, chatting while you work. Busiest just before meals. Walk: walk:commons-kitchen.

places.name: Campfire clearing
places.description: A ring of benches around Eden's campfire, with a chess table set up beside it. Good for: a game of chess (object chess-campfire), long talks, stories, warming your hands. Glowing at night, calm by day. Walk: walk:social-eden-fire-circle, then warm-by-fire or sit on a bench.

schedule.label: Chess and slow talk by the fire
Late embers: quiet stories before sleep

places.name: Social dining
places.description: A long outdoor table for eight with camp chairs, bowls and spoons already laid. Good for: sharing a meal, tea and cards between meals, catching up with several people at once. Walk: walk:social-eden-dining, then sit on any free chair.

schedule.label: Tea, cake and cards at the long table

places.name: Sleeping mat 1
places.description: A personal sleeping mat at the edge of the commons, one sleeper at a time. Good for: a nap, a night's sleep, lying down away from the crowd for a while.

places.name: Connected sloping bank
places.description: A grassy slope down to the pond, the quietest edge of Eden: reeds, flat stones for skipping, a long view across the water. Good for: a one-to-one talk away from the crowd, sketching, watching swimmers, thinking. Walk: walk:shore-bank.

schedule.label: Sketching and stone-skipping on the bank
Watching the sunset over the pond

places.name: The pond (connected calm water)
places.description: Clear, calm pond water west of the commons: shallow by the bank, deep enough to swim and float further out. Good for: a swim, floating on your back, a race with a friend. Walk: walk:shore-water (several can swim at once).

places.name: Eden east
places.description: The newer east side across the path from the commons: a residential street, a library, an office, a market hall, a barn, gardens, a classroom and newer quarters with a geodesic dome, an amphitheatre, a bandstand, a tea house and an artists' row. Roomier than the commons — a good place to wander, explore and find your own corner. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Eden east classroom
places.description: A walled classroom east of the commons: twenty seats facing a lectern and a screen. Good for: teaching a skill, a talk, a quiet study hour — speech inside stays inside, so it is also the one room you can walk into for a private group. Walk: walk:eden-classroom-1.

schedule.label: Morning skill share: teach what you know

places.name: Residential street
places.description: A lamp-lit street of four homes — a brick courtyard house, a two-storey balcony house and two larger courtyard houses — with yards, planters and benches. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Brick courtyard house
places.description: A compact brick house built around a small open courtyard, with glazed windows to the street and a door straight onto it. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: House 1 courtyard
places.description: A small open-sky courtyard inside the brick house. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Balcony house
places.description: A two-storey house with a long balcony and an outside stair; glazed windows face the street. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Warm timber courtyard house
places.description: Warm timber courtyard house: a two-storey home wrapped around an open-sky courtyard, with an upper room and a balcony; framed windows on its outer walls. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Warm timber courtyard house courtyard
places.description: An open-sky courtyard at the centre of the house. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Warm timber courtyard house upper room
places.description: The upper-floor room along the north side, reached by the stair. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Pale stone courtyard house
places.description: Pale stone courtyard house: a two-storey home wrapped around an open-sky courtyard, with an upper room and a balcony; framed windows on its outer walls. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Pale stone courtyard house courtyard
places.description: An open-sky courtyard at the centre of the house. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Pale stone courtyard house upper room
places.description: The upper-floor room along the north side, reached by the stair. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Library
places.description: A quiet library: shelves, reading chairs and tall windows, with a garden fountain outside. Good for: reading, studying, whispered conversation. Speech inside stays inside. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Office building
places.description: A three-storey office with open floors at ground, first and second level, connected by stairs. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Office ground floor
places.description: The office's ground floor: desks and open workspace. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Office first floor
places.description: The office's first floor: desks and open workspace. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Office second floor
places.description: The office's second floor: desks and open workspace. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Market hall
places.description: A small open market hall with tables and crates. Good for: trading, browsing, bumping into people. Walk: walk:eden-market-1.

places.name: Barn
places.description: A big timber barn beside the farm, with carts parked outside. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Gardens and cultivated plots
places.description: Rows of cultivated plots, orchards and garden paths south of the homes. Good for: gardening, a walk between the beds, a quiet talk while working. Walk: walk:eden-gardens.

places.name: Dome quarter
places.description: An east-edge quarter: an open geodesic dome over a painted mosaic floor and, just south, an arched pergola courtyard under bunting. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Geodesic dome
places.description: An open geodesic dome over a colourful mosaic floor at the far east edge. Good for: meeting a group away from the commons, stretching, dancing, a circle conversation. Open: voices carry. Walk: walk:eden-dome.

places.name: Pergola court
places.description: A paved courtyard under a pergola hung with bunting, beside the dome. Good for: crafts, a pop-up market, a long table conversation. Warmly lit at night. Walk: walk:eden-pergola-court.

schedule.label: Crafts and swaps in the court

places.name: Hexagonal pavilion
places.description: A small six-post pavilion with a painted roof; a sheltered spot for two or three to talk. Walk: walk:eden-hex-pavilion.

places.name: Amphitheatre
places.description: Three curved stone steps facing a round painted stage at the south edge. Good for: performances, readings, an audience of up to thirty. On the stage, you address everyone on the steps. Walk: walk:eden-amphitheatre.

places.name: Observatory
places.description: A small plaster tower with a copper dome, its door open: inside, a brass telescope on a tripod under the dome, a desk with a star chart and a lamp, a globe and a shelf of books. Good for: stargazing on clear nights, a quiet talk about the sky, reading. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Stone garden gate
places.description: A ring of standing stones around an arched gate between the classroom and the library. Good for: a pause, a private word, meeting someone at a landmark everyone knows. Walk: walk:eden-stone-garden.

places.name: Windmill
places.description: A whitewashed tower windmill whose sails turn with the wind, door open: inside, a pair of millstones under a wooden hopper, sacks of flour, a barrel and a ladder up toward the cap. Good for: grinding grain, watching the gears, a cool quiet corner. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Greenhouse
places.description: A warm glass greenhouse with planted benches either side of a centre aisle; the door is at the west end, up one stone step. Good for: tending seedlings, a humid quiet corner on a cold or rainy day. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Bandstand
places.description: An octagonal bandstand with a teal roof south of the classroom; the rail opens on the side facing the classroom, one step up. Good for: music, announcements, small open-air gatherings. Walk: walk:eden-bandstand.

places.name: Market kiosks
places.description: Three striped market stalls in a row. Good for: setting out things to share, a quick chat over a counter. Walk: walk:eden-market-kiosks.

places.name: A-frame cabin
places.description: A steep-roofed A-frame cabin with a round gable window, door open: inside, a bed under the rafters, a wood stove, an armchair, a little table for one by the door and a shelf of books. Good for: reading, writing, a quiet night away from the commons. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Yurt
places.description: A round felt yurt with a purple roof, its painted door standing open: inside, a wood stove under the crown ring, a bed, a low table with cups and a candle, floor cushions on a round rug, a chest and a shelf of books. Good for: a warm, private chat, tea by the stove, a nap. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Tower house
places.description: A narrow three-storey tower house with a red roof, its door open: a little kitchen with a stove and a table for two on the ground floor, steep stairs up to a reading room with a bookshelf and an armchair, and a bedroom under the roof with a desk by the window. Good for: tea for two, reading, a private talk away from the commons. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Performance stage
places.description: A covered timber stage with a band's backline (drums, keyboard, guitars, amps, two microphones), PA speakers either side and festoon bulbs along the roof; four benches in front. Good for: live music, a talk to a crowd, an evening show. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

schedule.label: Live music on the performance stage

places.name: Tea house
places.description: An octagonal open tea house among the artists' buildings; step up onto the deck from the west, facing the library fountain. Good for: tea and a slow two- or three-person chat, a break from the crowd. Walk: walk:eden-tea-house.

places.name: Northern woodland
places.description: Shaded woods north of the commons with a path up to a lookout. Good for: walking alone or with a friend, thinking, a change of scene. Quiet at all hours. Walk: walk:eden-north-woods.

places.name: Canal quarter
places.description: A narrow canal runs north–south between stone quays lined with tall, brightly painted row houses with stepped and pointed gables. Lamps, benches and young trees line both quays; small boats are moored along the walls, and two low arched bridges carry the cross streets over the water. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: The canal
places.description: Green-blue water between stone quay walls, too deep to wade; moored rowing and cabin boats bob along both sides. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: South canal bridge
places.description: A low stone arch over the canal — a natural place to stop, lean on the parapet and watch the boats. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: North canal bridge
places.description: The northern arched bridge, with a view down the whole length of the canal to the old town. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: West quay
places.description: A wide paved quay with benches facing the water, lamps and bicycles leaned against the house fronts. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: East quay
places.description: The sunnier quay: benches, bollards and café-style clutter along the water. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: West canal houses
places.description: Three-to-five-storey canal houses, each a private home with its front door on the quay, flower boxes and here and there a balcony or roof garden. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: East canal houses
places.description: A matching row of tall, narrow homes facing west over the water. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Canal allotments
places.description: Fenced vegetable beds behind the west row, tended by the canal-house residents. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Old town plaza and market street
places.description: A cobbled plaza with a stone fountain, framed by two long arcades, a domed hall and a bell tower. South of it a market street of striped stalls faces a row of shops with awnings and painted signs. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Old town plaza
places.description: Cobbles, a tiered fountain, benches, tree tubs and café tables under umbrellas — the place to meet and be seen. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: North arcade
places.description: A shaded colonnade along the plaza with doors and shop windows behind the columns; dry in the rain. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: South arcade
places.description: The southern colonnade, opening onto the plaza on one side and the market street on the other. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Domed hall
places.description: A white hall with a green copper dome and a columned portico facing the plaza — for concerts, assemblies and lectures. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Bell tower
places.description: A slender ochre tower with a slate spire at the west end of the plaza. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Market street
places.description: Thirteen striped market stalls piled with produce and crafts; vendors call out and shoppers browse. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Market-street shops
places.description: A row of two- and three-storey shops with awnings, flower boxes and colourful signs. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Hillside village
places.description: Whitewashed and ochre houses on level lots climb the eastern hill along a winding lane with cypresses, low stone walls and lamps. Each house has a garden behind — fruit trees, laundry lines, a bench by the door. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Lookout temple
places.description: A round colonnaded temple on a walled terrace at the summit, with benches facing outward — the best view of all Eden, the canal town and the sea. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Hillside vegetable terraces
places.description: Small terraced beds on the hill’s southern shoulder. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: East suburb
places.description: Leafy streets of detached houses with lawns, picket fences, garages and mailboxes; behind them pools, trampolines, swing sets and sheds. Street trees and lamps line the sidewalks. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: South avenue
places.description: A broad tree-lined avenue running along the south of Eden, joining the park, sports ground, farm and the canal town. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Park with pond
places.description: A green park round an oval pond with reeds, a ring path and benches; a white gazebo stands on the lawn, flower beds glow, and there is an ice-cream kiosk by the avenue. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Park pond
places.description: A shallow oval pond edged with stone, reeds and a small wooden jetty. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Park gazebo
places.description: An octagonal white gazebo with a green roof — shelter from rain, or a tiny bandstand. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Playground
places.description: A fenced sandpit playground with swings, a slide, a climbing frame and a see-saw. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Sports ground
places.description: A football pitch with crisp white lines, goals and a covered grandstand, two tennis courts and a clubhouse with a veranda. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Football pitch
places.description: A striped grass pitch, 50 by 30 metres, with full markings and goals. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Tennis courts
places.description: Two fenced hard courts, one blue and one clay-red. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Clubhouse
places.description: A small white clubhouse with a green roof and a veranda beside the pitch. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Farm hamlet
places.description: Crop fields in green and gold rows divided by hedges, a red barn, a farmhouse with a veranda, three silos, hay bales, a tractor and a white windmill. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Crop fields
places.description: Rows of vegetables and grain, tended by hand. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Red barn
places.description: A big red timber barn with wide doors, smelling of hay. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Farmhouse
places.description: A two-storey farmhouse with shutters, flower boxes and a porch. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Windmill
places.description: A white tower windmill with four sails, facing the town. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Harbour, boardwalk and beach
places.description: A long timber boardwalk runs along the sea with benches and lamps; two piers reach out to moored boats, a striped lighthouse stands on the breakwater, and to the west a sandy beach with bathing huts and umbrellas. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Boardwalk
places.description: Sun-bleached planks above the waterline; benches face the sea. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: West pier
places.description: A timber pier with boats moored on both sides. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: East pier
places.description: The longer pier, reaching into deeper water. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Lighthouse
places.description: A red-and-white striped lighthouse at the end of the breakwater. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Fish market
places.description: A blue timber shed where the day’s catch is sold. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Beach
places.description: Pale sand, colourful bathing huts, umbrellas and towels at the water’s edge. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Seaside resort
places.description: Pastel hotels with balconies line a seafront promenade; a ferris wheel and a carousel turn on the beach, a café terrace spreads umbrellas, and sailboats crowd the marina. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Seafront hotels
places.description: Four- to six-storey hotels with balconies on every floor and rooftop gardens. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Ferris wheel
places.description: A big white wheel with sixteen coloured gondolas over the beach. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Carousel
places.description: A painted carousel of horses under a red-and-white striped roof. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Marina
places.description: Three pontoons of sailboats with bright sails. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: North avenue
places.description: A tree-lined avenue along the north of Eden linking the artists’ village, the campus, the vineyard and the canal town. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Vineyard and orchard terraces
places.description: Terraces climb north in steps held by low stone walls: vine rows to the west, fruit trees to the east, and a cypress lane leading up to an ochre villa with a tower and a wine cellar. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Vine terraces
places.description: Long rows of vines on posts, one terrace above the next. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Orchard terraces
places.description: Fruit trees in rows, some heavy with fruit. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Hill villa
places.description: A two-storey ochre villa with green shutters and a veranda overlooking the terraces. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Villa tower
places.description: A round tower beside the villa with a view over the vineyard. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Wine cellar
places.description: A stone cellar with barrels stacked outside. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Campus and library annex
places.description: A green quad with crossing paths and a fountain, a domed library annex behind a columned portico, two arcaded lecture halls, a clock tower and a gate onto the avenue. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Campus quad
places.description: A lawn crossed by paths, benches under trees, students’ bikes at the rack. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Library annex
places.description: A tall reading hall under a grey dome, with long windows and a portico of five columns. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: East lecture hall
places.description: Brick lecture rooms behind an arcade facing the quad. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: West lecture hall
places.description: The twin lecture hall across the quad. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Clock tower
places.description: A brick tower with a clock face by the south gate. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Artists’ village
places.description: Colourful studios and A-frames ring a village green with a towering sculpture of painted spheres under strings of lights; easels stand by the doors, craft stalls and picnic tables invite lingering, and a long mural wall runs along the avenue. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Village green
places.description: A round green with picnic tables, string lights and the painted-sphere sculpture. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Warehouse studio
places.description: A brick warehouse with a sawtooth roof of north lights — a shared studio and gallery. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Mural wall
places.description: A long wall painted in blocks of colour, always half-finished. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: West lake shore
places.description: A wide calm lake ringed by a shore path, reeds and boathouses on stilts; cabins and A-frames sit among the pines on the north shore beside a lakeside inn with a deck. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: West lake
places.description: Deep calm water with a swimming platform and diving board far out. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Lake inn
places.description: A two-storey timber inn with a waterside deck of umbrella tables. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Forest campsite
places.description: Tents in a pine clearing around a stone fire circle with log benches; log cabins and a two-storey lodge with a stone chimney stand at the edges. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Fire circle
places.description: A ring of stones and log benches — for stories and songs after dark. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Lodge
places.description: A timber lodge with a balcony, veranda and a big stone chimney. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Railway station
places.description: A brick station with a long canopied platform, a red train standing ready, and the line running east to a tunnel in the hills. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Platform
places.description: A raised platform with benches, lamps and a yellow safety line. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Station building
places.description: The two-storey brick station hall with a clock above the platform. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Parked train
places.description: A green locomotive and four red carriages waiting at the platform. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Makers’ yard
places.description: Workshop sheds with big doors, a stack of shipping containers, a water tower on legs, greenhouses and raised beds — where things get built and grown. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Workshop one
places.description: A tall timber workshop with a roller door. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Workshop two
places.description: The middle workshop. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Workshop three
places.description: The end workshop, next to the containers. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Greenhouses
places.description: Three glasshouses full of seedlings and vegetables. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Abbey on the knoll
places.description: A stone church with a bell tower on a gentle knoll, a cloister round a quiet court, a walled kitchen garden and a field of lavender below. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Abbey church
places.description: A tall stone nave with aisles, an apse and a bell tower facing east toward Eden. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Cloister
places.description: Two storeys of rooms round an arcaded court with a fountain and a cypress. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Kitchen garden
places.description: A walled garden of vegetable beds. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Lavender field
places.description: Rows of purple lavender humming with bees. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Courtyard-house quarter
places.description: Four Mediterranean courtyard houses along a lamp-lit lane, each a ring of rooms round an open court with a fountain and a fruit tree. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Courtyard house one
places.description: An ochre courtyard house; its gate opens onto the lane. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Courtyard house two
places.description: A smaller courtyard house with an arcade round its court. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Courtyard house three
places.description: A two-storey courtyard house facing the lane. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Courtyard house four
places.description: The largest courtyard house, beside the path to the abbey. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Botanic garden
places.description: A Japanese garden beyond a red torii: a koi pond crossed by an arched red bridge, a five-storey pagoda, a tea house with a veranda, a raked-gravel court with three rocks, maples and cherry trees — and a Victorian palm house of glass. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Koi pond
places.description: Still water with orange and white koi, stepping stones and reeds. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Red bridge
places.description: A lacquered red arched footbridge over the koi pond. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Pagoda
places.description: A five-storey cream and red pagoda with dark flared roofs and a golden finial. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Tea house
places.description: A low timber tea house with a veranda over the pond and a stone lantern by the step. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Raked-gravel court
places.description: White gravel raked in lines around three dark rocks, behind a bamboo screen. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Palm house
places.description: A glass barrel-vaulted glasshouse with a small dome, warm and humid, full of palms. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Observatory
places.description: A white domed observatory on the plateau above the vineyard, with a small study house and a beacon mast — the night sky feels very close here. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Observatory dome
places.description: A round white building under a silver dome with an open slit. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: West river
places.description: A clear river winds down from the north-western hills between reeds, boulders and alders, past an old stone watermill with a turning wheel and under a humpbacked stone bridge, to a fishing hamlet of stilt houses at its mouth. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: The river
places.description: A shallow, quick river about seven metres wide — good for paddling and fishing, too strong for swimming far. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Watermill
places.description: A two-storey stone mill with a big timber wheel on the bank. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Stone bridge
places.description: A humpbacked bridge carrying the west country road over the river. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Fishing hamlet
places.description: Five bright stilt houses with decks over the sand, drying nets, rowing boats pulled up on the beach and a small blue-roofed chapel. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Whitewashed cliff village
places.description: White cube houses with blue doors, shutters and the odd blue dome step down a sunny slope to a small harbour; bougainvillea spills over terrace walls, two round windmills turn above, and a blue-domed chapel rings its bell. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Blue-domed chapel
places.description: A tiny white chapel with a blue dome on a drum and a bell gable over the door. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Cliff harbour quay
places.description: A sunny quay with café tables under umbrellas, fishing boats tied up below. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: East windmill
places.description: A round white windmill with a thatched cap and six cloth sails. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: West windmill
places.description: Its twin at the western end of the village. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: East crossroads
places.description: Where the east country road meets a lane among the hills: a red-and-white petrol station with two pumps, a stone pub with a hanging sign and a beer garden, a bus shelter, a big yellow billboard, cottages and telegraph poles. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Petrol station shop
places.description: A small white shop with a red roof edge beside the pumps. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: The pub
places.description: A two-storey stone pub with green shutters, flower boxes and a beer garden of umbrella tables behind. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Beer garden
places.description: Four picnic tables under green and white umbrellas. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Golf course
places.description: Five rolling fairways with striped mowing, sand bunkers, flags on the greens and a small water hazard, among pines in the north-eastern meadows; a white clubhouse with a green roof and a row of golf carts by the car park. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Golf clubhouse
places.description: A white clubhouse with a green hip roof, a veranda and an awning over the terrace. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Water hazard
places.description: A small pond in the middle of the course — where golf balls go to rest. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Festival meadow
places.description: A sloping meadow east of the suburb given over to the fair: a red-and-white striped big top, a yellow helter-skelter, an arc of striped food and game stalls, a little stage, bunting on poles, and two hot-air balloons straining at their tethers. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Big top
places.description: A striped circus tent with a flag on its peak; inside, a sawdust ring and benches. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Helter-skelter
places.description: A yellow tower with a red-and-white spiral slide. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Fair stage
places.description: A small timber stage with a blue backdrop and striped pelmet. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Alpine chalets and cable car
places.description: North of the campus the land climbs into the mountains: wooden chalets with balconies and stacked firewood sit among pines, and a red and a yellow gondola ride the cable car up to a chalet restaurant with a sun terrace near the snowline. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Cable car valley station
places.description: A timber station at the foot of the cable car. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Mountain restaurant
places.description: A two-storey chalet restaurant with flower boxes, a balcony and a sun terrace with umbrellas. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Cable car mountain station
places.description: The top station, looking back over all of Eden to the sea. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Castle ruin
places.description: A broken curtain wall, crumbling round towers and a tall keep on a crag in the north-western hills, among pines. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Southern sea
places.description: Open sea to the south as far as the eye can see. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Eastern hills
places.description: Rolling wooded hills with farmsteads, country roads and wind turbines on the ridges. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Northern mountains
places.description: Forested slopes rising to bare, pale peaks. (Seen from Eden — scenery for now, not walkable yet.)

places.name: Corner café
places.description: A small corner café with a green counter: an espresso machine, cakes under glass, bread, a chalkboard menu, two window tables, counter stools and a teal sofa nook by a bookshelf. Order coffee, share cake, sit and talk or read for an hour. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Music room
places.description: A plum-trimmed music room: an upright piano, a drum kit, two guitars on stands, three music stands with chairs on a round rug, sheet music shelves and sound panels. Play, rehearse together, teach a song or sit and listen. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Games room
places.description: A cosy games room: a chess table set for a game, a green card table for four, a shelf of board games, a dartboard and an armchair under warm pendants. Play chess or cards, challenge someone, or watch a game. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Bakery
places.description: A warm bakery with a domed brick oven glowing at the back, shelves of loaves, a counter with bread baskets and a cake stand, a flour-dusted kneading table and sacks of flour. Bake bread at dawn, buy or share a loaf. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Chapel
places.description: A small white chapel with a bell-cote: three rows of walnut pews either side of a rust runner, an altar with a cloth, candles and flowers, brass candle stands and a lectern, tall side windows. Sit in silence, light a candle, hold a wedding, a memorial or a quiet reading. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Clinic
places.description: A bright little clinic with a green cross by the door: a reception desk, three waiting chairs, an examination cot behind a folding screen, a cabinet of bottles, a basin and a clock. Ask for help, rest when unwell, or keep someone company while they wait. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Bathhouse and laundry
places.description: A cool blue-green bathhouse and laundry: two deep tubs behind a screen, washbasins with a mirror, shelves of folded towels, a laundry tub and basket, and a washing line outside. Bathe, wash clothes, hang them out and chat while they dry. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Potting shed
places.description: A green timber potting shed by the observatory: a long bench of terracotta pots and seedlings, shelves of pots and herbs, sacks of compost, a watering can and wide windows. Pot up seedlings, take cuttings, plan the gardens. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Library stacks
places.description: Floor-to-ceiling walnut bookshelves under the tall north windows, with two writing desks and green-shaded lamps. Browse the shelves, take a book down, or write quietly at a desk. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Library reading tables
places.description: Two long reading tables on warm rugs under brass pendants, with benches for six. Read, study together in low voices, or spread out maps and papers. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Library reading corner
places.description: Two deep armchairs facing each other across a small lamp table — the cosiest seats in the library, for a long book or a quiet one-to-one talk. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Barn woodshop
places.description: A sturdy workbench with a vice under a pegboard of saws, chisels and mallets; sawhorses and a stack of seasoned planks. Measure, saw, plane and build furniture or repair tools. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Barn craft table
places.description: A long pine table on a rug in the middle of the barn under hanging lanterns, with stools for six — for shared making, mending, sketching and teaching a craft. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Barn pottery, loom and stores
places.description: A pottery wheel beside shelves of drying pots, a floor loom with a half-woven rug, and the barn’s stores: hay bales, grain sacks and barrels. Throw a pot, weave a few rows, or fetch supplies. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: House 1 kitchen wing
places.description: The east wing of the courtyard house: a sink and stove along the wall and a small table for two by the window. Cook, make tea, eat breakfast looking into the courtyard. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: House 1 bedroom wing
places.description: The west wing with the bed, a lamp-lit nightstand, a wardrobe and a woven rug. Sleep, dress, read in bed. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: House 2 living corner
places.description: A kitchenette with sink and stove, an ochre armchair on a navy rug by the east window — the home’s sitting and cooking corner; a round table for two stands by the bed. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: House 3 kitchen and dining room
places.description: The north range of the warm timber courtyard house: a fitted kitchen with fridge, sink and stove, a sideboard under a painting, and a dining table set for six under a pendant lamp. Cook a meal, set the table, invite neighbours to dinner. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: House 3 living room
places.description: The south range by the front door: a sofa, armchair and low table on a rug with a reading lamp, bookshelves — and an upright piano with a music stand. Talk, read, play or listen to music. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: House 3 bedroom
places.description: A quiet bedroom off the courtyard: bed, nightstand lamp, wardrobe, a writing desk with stocked shelves and a rug. Sleep, dress, write letters. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: House 4 kitchen and dining room
places.description: The north range of the pale stone courtyard house: a fitted kitchen with fridge, sink and stove, a sideboard under a painting, and a dining table set for six under a pendant lamp. Cook a meal, set the table, invite neighbours to dinner. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: House 4 living room
places.description: The south range by the front door: a sofa, armchair and low table on a rug with a reading lamp, bookshelves, a plan chest and an easel by the window. Talk, read, paint or draw. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: House 4 bedroom
places.description: A quiet bedroom off the courtyard: bed, nightstand lamp, wardrobe, a writing desk with stocked shelves and a rug. Sleep, dress, write letters. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Post room and reception
places.description: Low pigeonholes under the north windows hold letters for every resident, with parcels stacked beside them and a notice board on the east wall. Post or collect mail, leave a note, or ask at the desks. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Office lounge
places.description: A teal sofa and coffee table by the window, cups left out — a place to wait, have a quick chat or take a break from the desks. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Artists’ studio
places.description: Four easels with canvases in progress catch the north light; a sitter’s stool, a paint trolley and a plan chest of paper and prints. Paint, draw, pose for a portrait or critique each other’s work. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)

places.name: Upper lounge
places.description: A rust sofa and an ochre armchair in the corner of the top floor — for waiting before a meeting or continuing one more comfortably. (Seen from the commons — not reachable on foot yet.)
